meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Agar aap **oily skin** ke liye **₹500 ke andar** ek face wash lena chahte ho, to meri sabse practical shortlist ye hogi: **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash**, **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash**, aur **Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Facial Wash**.[3][6]

- **Best overall for oily/acne-prone skin:** **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** — oily skin aur frequent breakouts ke liye useful option ke roop me recommend kiya gaya hai.[3][6]
- **Best gentle daily cleanser:** **Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Facial Wash** — agar aapko oil control chahiye but skin ko zyada strip nahi karna, to ye safer daily-use option hai.[3]
- **Best budget pick:** **Garnier Pure Active Neem Face Wash** — sabse sasta aur oily skin ke liye budget-friendly choice ke roop me listed hai.[3]
- **Best balanced option:** **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** — oily skin aur small breakouts ke liye achha option bataya gaya hai.[3]

Agar aap *sirf ek* choose karna chahte ho, to **oily + acne-prone skin** ke liye **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** sabse strong pick hai.[3][6] Agar skin **sensitive** hai ya zyada dryness hoti hai, to **Simple** better rahega.[3]

**Quick buying rule:**
- **Zyada pimples / blackheads:** salicylic acid वाला face wash
- **Sirf oiliness:** green tea / neem based cleanser
- **Sensitive skin:** gentle, soap-free cleanser

Chaaho to main aapke liye **₹500 ke andar top 5 face washes ka exact comparison** bhi kar dunga.
